QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Mantis Infestation
QuestInfo.0: Continue the conversation with Kona at the Explorer Base.
QuestInfo.1: According to #bKona#k at the #bExplorer Base#k, monster populations are making exploration difficult. Go to #bColossus West Road#k, and clear out #r50 Mantises and 50 Blood Mantises#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went to #bColossus West Road#k, cleared out #r50 Mantises and 50 Blood Mantises#k, and helped #bKona#k continue her exploration.

0.0: I'm happy! So, so happy! I think my brain might explode!\r\nI had no idea you were into exploring. That's like my number one THING! Besties!\r\n
0.1: You should probably know your new best friend's name. I'm #bKona#k! I work for that old goat over there, #bLavi#k. I'm just his assistant for now, but I'm gonna grow up to be THE best explorer ever.
0.2: Did #bLavi#k blow you off? He always does that. It's just 'cause of all the #rmonsters#k around here. \r\nHey, you look pretty strong, don't you? You have rugged combat-tested muscles. You ARE a fighter, right?
0.3: So cool! Go beat up a bunch of #rMantises#k and #rBlood Mantises#k. Can you smush #r50#k of each? I bet you can.

yes.0: Keep heading east to find the Mantises. Ya can't miss 'em!\r\n#b(Take out 50 Mantises and Blood Mantises.)#k

no.0: My new besty cannot be a wimp.

1.0: You handled them ALREADY? Wow. So action!

yes.0: I bet #bLavi#k will want to talk to you now. He likes when things get smushed.\r\n#b(Talk to Lavi.)#k

mob.0: Keep heading east to find the Mantises. Ya can't miss 'em!\r\n#b(Take out 50 Mantises and Blood Mantises.)#k\r\n
